# ractermx_check_override (Resource)

Manages a per-domain security check override in RacterMX.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Override a security check for a specific domain.
resource "ractermx_check_override" "disable_dmarc_strict" {
  domain_id         = ractermx_domain.example.id
  check_id          = "dmarc_strict_policy"
  enabled           = false
  severity_override = "low"
}

resource "ractermx_domain" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `check_id` (String) The ID of the security check to override. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `domain_id` (Number) The numeric ID of the domain. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the check is enabled for this domain.
- `severity_override` (String) Override severity level (critical, high, medium, low, informational).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The composite ID of the check override ({domain_id}/{check_id}).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a check override using the composite key format: {domain_id}/{check_id}
terraform import ractermx_check_override.disable_dmarc_strict 123/dmarc_strict_policy
```
